context: A mom shops for clothes with her young son
purpose: Teach: まじめ/貧乏/ときどき/ついつい/おまけ/パンツ/ふえ/やってくる

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日はあなたの服を買いに来たのよ。最近、背が伸びたわね。
lines.en: We came to buy your clothes today. You've gotten taller lately.
lines.style: Warm maternal tone, mid-volume, gentle pace with affectionate observation

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、見て!このズボンかっこいい!ヒーローの絵が付いてる!
lines.en: Mom, look! These pants are so cool! They have a hero picture on them!
lines.style: Excited child voice, high-pitched, energetic and bouncing with enthusiasm

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あらあら、ときどき派手なの選ぶよね。もう少しまじめなデザインはどう?
lines.en: Oh my, sometimes you pick such flashy ones. How about a more sensible design?
lines.style: Soft chuckling tone, slightly teasing, patient with mild exasperation

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: やだー!こっちがいい!ねえ、おまけのシール付いてるパンツもほしい!
lines.en: No way! I want this one! Hey, I also want the underwear with the bonus sticker!
lines.style: Whiny pleading child voice, bouncing energy, rising pitch on demands

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ついつい甘やかしちゃうのよね。でも、うちはそんなにお金ないのよ。
lines.en: I keep spoiling you without meaning to. But we don't have that much money, you know.
lines.style: Mock-stern motherly voice, half-laughing, gentle scolding with warmth

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: えー、うちって貧乏なの?じゃあパパが帰ってくるまで待つ?
lines.en: Huh, are we poor? Then should we wait until Daddy gets home?
lines.style: Innocent curious child voice, head-tilting tone, genuine confusion

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、冗談よ。ほら、店員さんがやってくるから、ちゃんと並んでね。
lines.en: Haha, I was joking. Look, the clerk is coming over, so line up properly.
lines.style: Reassuring laugh, gentle guiding voice, quick mother-to-child redirection

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: はーい!ねえママ、お買い物のたびに僕の荷物がふえちゃうね!
lines.en: Okaaay! Hey Mom, every time we shop my stuff just keeps increasing!
lines.style: Bright obedient child voice, sing-song agreement, cheerful final announcement
